name: prescripto
description: Prescripto - doctor appointment booking (backend API, patient app, admin panel)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix admin test
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
